tests.name: Hero passive: Malachar Level 13 Elemental Dominion ignores exactly 1 Armor in actual Fire Attack damage

printed.Innate Ability: Master Arcane Overload — Up to twice per Round, after you play an Attack card that costs 2 or more Actions, you may Overload it. That Attack gains +3 Attack. After it resolves, Malachar suffers 1 damage. Elemental Reservoir — The first two times each Round Malachar would suffer damage from one of his own Hero card or Equipment effects, reduce that damage by 1, minimum 0. Elemental Momentum — Once per Round after Malachar defeats an Enemy with a Fire or Lightning Attack, draw 1 card. Living Cataclysm — Once per Quest, when Malachar Overloads an Attack, he may increase that Attack by an additional +2 Attack. After it resolves, Malachar suffers 1 additional damage. Elemental Chain — Once per Round after Malachar resolves an Overloaded Attack, choose another Enemy in the target's Location. That Enemy suffers 1 damage. Cataclysm Unbound — Once per Quest when Malachar uses Living Cataclysm, the Overloaded Attack gains +3 additional Attack instead of +2, and self-damage from that Attack cannot reduce Malachar below 1 Health. Overload Mastery — The first time each Round Malachar would suffer self-damage from one of his own cards or abilities, reduce that damage by 1, minimum 0. If any damage is prevented this way, his next Attack that Round gains +1 Attack. Elemental Apotheosis — Once per Quest, spend 1 Action. Until the end of Malachar's next turn, his damaging Hero cards gain +2 damage, may treat their damage as Fire or Lightning after targets are chosen, and his self-damage cannot reduce him below 1 Health. Storm of Elements — Once per Round after Malachar deals Fire or Lightning damage, his next damaging Hero card that Round may deal the other type and gains +1 damage. Living Cataclysm — Once per Quest, spend 1 Action. Until the end of Malachar's turn, each damaging Hero card gains +3 damage and may affect one additional legal target in the same Location. Malachar's Fire and Lightning effects ignore 1 Armor; Frost effects reduce target Move by 1 until end next activation.
printed.Core Mechanic: Overload; self-damage; Fire and Lightning; burst damage; area attacks
printed.reason: No complete independent effect oracle registered for this record.

tests.name: Hero passive: Veyra Level 14 Doom Script reduces actual target Armor only with two harmful statuses

printed.Innate Ability: Malefic Hex — Once per Round after Veyra applies a harmful Status Effect to an Enemy, her next Attack against that Enemy this Round gains +2 Attack. Lingering Curse — The first harmful Status Effect Veyra applies each Round lasts until the end of the target's next activation unless its normal duration is longer. Soul Siphon — Once per Round after Veyra defeats an Enemy with a harmful Status Effect, recover 1 Health or draw 1 card. Greater Malefic Hex — Once per Round after Veyra applies a harmful Status Effect to an Enemy, her next Attack against that Enemy this Round gains +3 Attack. Spreading Misery — Once per Round after an afflicted Enemy is defeated, Veyra may give one harmful Status Effect it had to another Enemy in the same Location. Queen of Curses — Once per Quest, choose a Location within 2 connections. Each Enemy there gains Weakened and Marked until the end of its next activation. Hexmaster — The first time each Round Veyra applies a harmful Status Effect to an Enemy, that Enemy also becomes Marked until the end of its next activation. Curse Cascade — Once per Quest, choose Veyra's Location or a connected revealed Location. Each Enemy there gains Weakened and Marked until the end of its next activation, then choose one of those Enemies to also become Rooted. Doomweaver — Once per Round when Veyra applies a harmful Status Effect to an Enemy, choose another Enemy in that Location. Apply the same Status to that Enemy if it is a legal recipient. Malison Eternal — Once per Quest, spend 1 Action. Choose up to 3 Enemies in Veyra's Location or a connected Location. Each gains one harmful Status Effect Veyra can normally apply; until the end of her next turn, her Attacks against those Enemies ignore 2 Armor. Master of Ruin — The first time each Round Veyra damages an Enemy with a harmful Status Effect, spread one of that Enemy's harmful Status Effects to another legal Enemy in the same Location. Curse of the Last Name — Once per Quest, choose one Enemy. Until it is defeated, it suffers -2 Armor and cannot remove harmful Status Effects except through Boss/Quest immunity rules. When Veyra applies a harmful Status, once per Round she may apply a weaker or shorter copy of it to another Enemy in the same Location. Enemies with 2 or more harmful Status Effects suffer -1 Armor.
printed.Core Mechanic: Hexes; harmful Status Effects; Shadow damage; exploiting afflicted enemies
